assignmentTitle: Senior Fullstack Developer – Kotlin / Java & React - Stockholm
profileParagraphs: Joel is a senior fullstack developer and software architect with more than 14 years of experience developing and maintaining production systems. He combines deep Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL and API design experience with hands-on React and TypeScript frontend delivery, and has worked in finance, e-health, education, culture, accessibility and startup environments.

He has built business-critical payment flows, integration-heavy distributed systems, accessible web applications and long-lived product platforms. Joel is an analytical problem solver who quickly understands complex technical flows and organizations, contributes with architecture and implementation, and supports teams through code review, debugging, quality practices and knowledge sharing.

Joel also brings practical experience from AI-assisted development initiatives, including Cursor and LLM-based workflows for refactoring, JUnit test generation, legacy-code documentation, SQL generation, database optimization, API contracts and best-practice analysis.
